arguments.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean start, but it currently feels quite minimal — it mainly just shows your email address. I'd suggest adding a bit more about yourself, such as your background, interests, or a portfolio of your work, to give visitors a better sense of who you are. Also, consider making your email a clickable mailto link for easier contact. Hope this helps!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you share your passion for hiking — it gives the site a personal and genuine touch. To make it even better, you could add more content like detailed hiking trip stories, photos, trail recommendations, or tips for fellow hikers. A consistent posting schedule and a clear navigation menu would also help readers explore your blog more easily. Keep it up!
